blocks.html: Preconfigured report templates can be edited, and you can build your own from scratch.

slides.title: Start a custom template
slides.html: To edit a default template, choose the report type and select Edit next to it — it opens in the editor to save as a new custom template. To build a new one, select + next to the Custom category; this creates an empty template with one section and a text field.

slides.title: Name it and add sections
slides.html: Enter a name in the Template Type field (this becomes the stored template name). Use the editor to add sections and fields, delete a section or field, mark a section Required, or Clear the template.

slides.title: Add field types
slides.html: Select + within a section to add a field: Options, Multi-Select Options, Section, Checkbox, Date, Location, Number with Units, Number, Range, Route, Text or Time.

slides.title: Save the template
slides.html: Drag the window out to see a live preview on the right as you build. Select Save to store it under Custom using its title, Save As to give it a new name, or Save / Fill Out to store it and immediately start a report from it.

slides.title: Reports preferences
slides.html: Tailor the report layout under Settings > Tool Preferences > Reporting Preferences: Allow sending to TAK users over Data Package, send Data Packages to all contacts automatically, and show or hide the Importance, Scale, Scale Description and User Description fields.
